description: This file implements a custom EventSource class for server-sent events (SSE) using React Native's networking API, including handling of event stream parsing, reconnection logic, and event dispatching.

classes.name: EventSource
classes.description: A class implementing server-sent events (SSE) client using React Native's networking, with custom parsing and reconnection logic.

methods.name: setTrackingName
methods.description: Sets a custom tracking name for the EventSource instance.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the EventSource connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: __connnect
methods.description: Establishes a new network request for the SSE stream.

methods.name: __reconnect
methods.description: Attempts to re-establish the connection after an error.

methods.name: __processEventStreamChunk
methods.description: Processes a chunk of data from the event stream, handling BOM and line parsing.

methods.name: __processEventStreamLine
methods.description: Parses a line from the event stream buffer and updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: __dispatchBufferedEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event based on the accumulated data buffer.

methods.name: __didCreateRequest
methods.description: Callback for when a network request is created.

methods.name: __didReceiveResponse
methods.description: Handles the response headers and status for the network request.

methods.name: __didReceiveIncrementalData
methods.description: Handles incremental data received from the network request.

methods.name: __didCompleteResponse
methods.description: Handles completion of the network response, including error handling and reconnection logic.
